assets.prompt: Using the supplied approved Cara sprite sheet as exact identity reference, generate ONE HEAD ONLY: the attentive listening pose. Same abstract ageless warm ivory pebble-shaped head with blue ink contour and small side-swept silhouette flick at upper right. No realistic human child traits, no ears, no neck, no added hair lines, no nose. Pose: head slightly turned to the viewer's left and tilted about 8 degrees, lifted as if offering an ear and listening intently; eyes looking gently up toward the person speaking, with subtly raised brows and a tiny calm closed smile. Achieve turn through small asymmetry and facial placement, not realistic 3D or shadow. The silhouette, eye size, simplemarks and stroke weight must remain recognizably the same as the approved heads. Minimal flat line art, blue #2455A6 contours, solid warm ivory interior. Genuine transparent exterior. NO halos, glow, gradients, shadows, no texture, no text. Center fully visible isolated head with generous transparent margins. This is an additional registered sprite expression for a very small onscreen assistant.

Create a stop-motion SPAWN-IN / DRAWN-IN sprite sheet for the exact abstract Cara head shown in the reference. SIX frames in a regular 3-column by 2-row grid, read left to right then next row. Every cell has equal dimensions and the same central registration point. Sequence: (1) a tiny loose blue ink spiral at the exact center, just two small loops; (2) the swirl opens outward, a loose circular gestural scribble still small and centered; (3) the swirly line expands into a partly drawn wide pebble head outline with its characteristic small sideways silhouette flick at upper right; (4) nearly completed head contour, a little residual spiral line trailing inward, empty ivory face; (5) full approved head silhouette with two eyes and small eyebrow marks being drawn, a tiny unfinished mouth stroke; (6) the finished approved Cara head with closed friendly smile, identical to the reference top-left neutral expression. The head forms by drawing outward from its center; no growing baby, no biological morph, no literal explosion or magic particles. From SIMPLE AND SWIRLY to the final clear line drawing. Preserve exact final blue ink (#2455A6), ivory fill, abstract ageless proportions and upper-right outline hair suggestion. No separate hair marks or upright curl. Frames 3-6 keep the same final head scale and center so final frames register; early spiral frames occupy only 10-35 percent of that same head area, not zoomed to fill the cell. Strong empty gutters, no cell borders. True transparent exterior. Flat line art only, no glow, shadows, gradients, texture, labels, numbers, or text. Each cell must contain only its single frame, isolated with nothing crossing to another cell. This is a practical 6-frame stop-motion sprite atlas, not a comic illustration.
